headline: MCA reportedly seeks to widen CSR scope to include PM Internship Scheme
summary_points: Business Standard reports that MCA is seeking to broaden the scope of permissible CSR spending.
As reported, the proposed expansion would cover the PM Internship Scheme.
Full details, such as the mode of change (Schedule VII amendment or otherwise), are not available in the material.
Effective date and any conditions have not been confirmed; await official MCA notification.
who_is_affected: Companies covered by Section 135 CSR obligations, along with their CSR committees and advisers.
action_required: Track the official MCA notification or draft and avoid changing CSR plans until the change is formally notified.

social.linkedin:
CSR spending may soon cover more ground.

According to a Business Standard report dated 19 November 2026, the Ministry of Corporate Affairs is seeking to broaden the scope of CSR spending, with the PM Internship Scheme reportedly to be included.

The report does not confirm the legal route, the effective date or any conditions, and no official notification has been quoted. These details matter for how eligible CSR activities are defined.

What this could mean for companies:
- A possible new avenue for CSR deployment
- A need to review annual action plans and CSR policies once the change is notified
- Documentation and reporting considerations for CSR committees

Until the MCA publishes an official notification or draft, treat this as a reported development only.

Please verify with the official MCA source before acting on it.
